dedupe_keys.name: jrc natech risk management guidance for operators of hazardous industrial sites and national authorities eur 31122 2022

description: This JRC technical report gives operators of hazardous industrial sites and national authorities step-by-step guidance on managing Natech risk, the release of toxic substances, fires and explosions when earthquakes, floods, storms and other natural hazards strike installations that process, store or transport hazardous materials. It describes the process of Natech risk analysis in a systematic way and sets it in the context of the 2012 amendment of the EU Seveso Directive, which made Natech risk an explicit requirement, and of earlier guidance from INERIS, the OECD and national bodies, which it complements as the first complete technical guidance for operators. It was written by Amos Necci and Elisabeth Krausmann of the European Commission's Joint Research Centre and published in 2022 as EUR 31122 EN. Coverage is the European Union. The report is available to download free and its reuse is authorised under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the copy read is hosted by IDRiM, not the JRC repository, and it is guidance, not a dataset, so equipment damage models must be taken from the literature it cites. For simulation it sets out the chain from natural hazard to equipment damage, release and consequences that Natech scenario models of chemical plants need to follow. It is related to the eNATECH natural hazard-triggered technological accidents database record in this catalogue.
